front.zh: 現代俳句 & 變奏   系列《7》

en: A bird flies past, the sky remains
The boat passes, the water leaves no trace
Just like this, is it really so?
The tide has ebbed
Seashell
Looking back at the vast sea

points.zh:
牛頓 ( 1643~1727)。蘇格蘭物理學家，天文學家，數學家，自然哲學家。萬有引力及運動三大定律，顏色理論，微積分學等創述者。
「 我不知道世人怎樣看我，但我自己以爲，我不過像一個在海邊玩耍的孩子，不時爲發現比尋常更爲美麗的卵石或貝殼而沾沾自喜，至于展現在我面前浩瀚的真理海洋，却全然一無所知。」
points.en:
Newton (1643–1727). Scottish physicist, astronomer, mathematician, and natural philosopher. Originator of universal gravitation and the three laws of motion, the theory of color, calculus, and more.
"I do not know what I may appear to the world, but to myself I seem to have been only like a boy playing on the seashore, and diverting myself in now and then finding a smoother pebble or a prettier shell than ordinary, whilst the great ocean of truth lay all undiscovered before me."

en: At the turning point of the years
A few scars
Wrinkling a pond of spring water
Notes on daily life
A few lines slipped through, missed
Is blankness perhaps another form of practice?
That stretch of the past where clouds and mist drifted
Stranded upon
The edge of regret
Books, like green mountains, are forever piled in disarray
Opened -- flew out
The years of the white egret

points.zh:
清代文學家紀曉嵐自題書齋聯：
「 書似青山常亂疊；燈如紅豆最相思 」
《 咱台灣 》
1929年蔡培火於牢獄中作這首歌的詞和曲。
台灣    台灣   咱台灣
海真闊   山真高
大船小船的路關
遠來人客講伊美
日月潭   阿里山
草木不時青跳跳
白鷺鷥過水田
水牛腳脊烏秋叫
太平洋上和平村
海真闊   山真高
( 歌詞共三節，取第一節。在第三節中有「東洋瑞士穩當成」一句，足見蔡培火對台灣鄉土的期許和當家做主的遠見。)
points.en:
The Qing dynasty man of letters Ji Xiaolan wrote this couplet for his own studio:
"Books are like green mountains, forever piled in disarray; a lamp is like a red bean, the most evocative of longing."
'Our Taiwan'
In 1929, Tsai Pei-huo wrote the words and music of this song while in prison.
Taiwan, Taiwan, our Taiwan,
the sea truly vast, the mountains truly tall,
a route traveled by ships large and small,
visitors from afar praise its beauty.
Sun Moon Lake, Ali Mountain,
grass and trees forever green and lively,
egrets crossing the paddies,
crows perched on the backs of water buffalo.
A village of peace upon the Pacific,
the sea truly vast, the mountains truly tall.
(The song has three verses; only the first is given here. In the third verse there is a line, "the Switzerland of the East will surely succeed," which shows Tsai Pei-huo's hopes for his native Taiwan and his far-sighted vision of self-determination.)

en: The color of the grass spreads along the way
Parallel roads grow farther apart the longer we walk
Dusk slowly rises
How shall I write the mood of this season
The next few lines
Will finally go with you

zh: 那些日子真的過去了嗎 ?
en: Dusk descends upon the Chianan Plain
Have those days truly passed?
Bicycle days

zh: 民歌如落葉 : " Blowin' in the Wind "
en: Autumn day, the Berkeley campus
History crosses over the stele's shadow
Folk songs like falling leaves: " Blowin' in the Wind "

points.zh: 加州柏克萊大學 ( UC Berkeley ) 學生在1964~1965年發起言論自由運動，爭取公民及學生言論自由， 學術自由和政治自由的民權運動。言論自由運動風起雲湧，至少有3000名學生持續參與，并與「非裔美國人民權運動」，「反越戰運動」等緊密串聯。言論自由運動是二十世紀六十年代，第一場爭取民權的學生反抗運動，是美國民權運動的里程碑。對美國社會以及世界各地產生了深遠的影響，改變了幾世代人對政治和道德的看法。而柏克萊大學也成為美國最自由，最包容，是活躍的大學之一。爲了紀念此次運動，柏克萊校園內設立了言論自由咖啡廳 ( Free Speech Movement Café )。在Sproul廣場，建立一個圓形花崗岩紀念碑, 上面刻著 「 This soil and the air space extending above it shall not be a part of any nation and shall not be subject to any entity's jurisdiction」( 此方土地以及上方空間不屬於任何國家，也不為任何組織團体所管轄 )。

**
《 Blowin' in the Wind 》 Bob Dylan  詞曲。  1963
How many years can a mountain exist
Before it's washed to the sea ?
How many years must some people exist
Before they're allowed to be free ?
And how many times can a man turn his head
And pretend that he just doesn't see - the answer
The answer, my friend, is blowin' in the wind
The answer is blowin' in the wind
--〔節錄第2段〕
這是 Bob Dylan廣為流傳的反戰經典歌曲，亦是他成名之作。此曲意涵著深遠的社會意識，公民覺醒，和民權思想，以及對戰爭，非人道行爲的控訴，激發了柏克萊言論自由，思想開放的學生運動，也因而奠定了Bob Dylan 在民歌的前衛地位。2016 Bob Dylan榮獲諾貝爾文學獎。
